app_info.subtitle: Build and operate a startup
app_info.description: SparkLaunch helps founders select or create a business project, manage and assign general project tasks, validate an idea, generate brand assets, publish measurable campaigns and landing pages, inspect performance, operate private CRM workflows, model ownership with SparkCap, prepare controlled investor rooms with SparkRoom, model and close SAFE investments with SparkClose, prepare entitlement-gated incorporation cases with secure participant tasks, and run monthly Founder Close reporting, reviewed room refreshes, obligations, and approved internal operations.

test_cases.description: List the connected user's accessible projects before scoped work.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the SparkLaunch projects I can access so I can choose one.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise list of accessible projects by name, status, and plan without exposing internal identifiers or versions.

test_cases.description: Create a private idea-validation workspace in a selected project.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a validation project for an AI bookkeeping assistant for independent contractors in project 42.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates one validation record in the selected project and reports its human-readable name and status without exposing internal identifiers or versions.

test_cases.description: Generate saved brand palette options from a concrete brief.
test_cases.user_prompt: Generate a trustworthy, modern color palette for my contractor bookkeeping product in project 42.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns saved palette options by name, hex values, and feeling labels without exposing internal identifiers or versions.

test_cases.description: List private landing-page projects without requiring seeded records.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the landing-page projects in SparkLaunch project 42.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the landing-page projects visible in the selected SparkLaunch project without exposing internal identifiers or versions; no records are changed.

test_cases.description: Prepare a first-party business-card import without importing an image.
test_cases.user_prompt: Prepare a secure business-card import for project 42, but do not import anything until I explicitly upload it in SparkLaunch.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an expiring first-party SparkLaunch action link and clearly states that nothing has been imported yet, without exposing internal identifiers or versions.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general startup education with no SparkLaunch operation.

negative_test_cases.expected_output: Answers generally without invoking SparkLaunch because no connected workspace action was requested.
